answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the crystal check immediately, the sparrow audit keeps the resolved set and the juniper replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 116 aliases hence pays the reading cost 116 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission.
